summary: Tested the verified-driver 'Change home location' feature end to end. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. PUT /api/pro/home for an approved driver applies right away and returns the new home with place and geo. In the DB, pro_drivers.home is updated, service_taluk_codes puts the new code first, drops the old home code and keeps the other service taluks. A home_history entry is pushed and an admin_notifications 'driver_home_changed' entry is created. Repeat changes (3 in a row) are allowed. Unknown taluk returns 400, no auth returns 401/403 and a rider with no pro profile returns 404. A pending driver with a home gets 400 with the exact message. A pending driver with no home can still set one. Frontend (390x844): driver login shows dash-taluk, dash-change-home and dash-tile-home, and both open /hire/home-location. That screen shows the current home card. Save is disabled (aria-disabled) until a taluk is chosen. Place search for Thamarassery auto-detects 'Thamarassery Taluk, Kozhikode, Kerala'. Save shows the toast 'Home location updated', goes back, and the dashboard shows 'Thamarassery, Thamarassery, Kozhikode'. Changing the taluk by hand (home-new-taluk-change, then state 32, district 561, subdistrict 5640) also saves. /hire/register for the rider still shows pro-home-place, pro-home-state, pro-home-district and pro-home-subdistrict. Picking Kunnamangalam there shows pro-home-taluk 'Kozhikode Taluk' with the pro-home-taluk-change link. There were no page errors.

minor.issue: There is no check that place (loc_id/lat/lng) is inside subdistrict_code. Picking the place Thamarassery and then choosing Kozhikode taluk by hand saved home.place_name='Thamarassery' with taluk Kozhikode, so the dashboard showed 'Thamarassery, Kozhikode, Kozhikode'. The frontend HomePlacePicker keeps the place when the taluk is changed by hand (the registration flow shares the same picker).

issues: The dash-taluk line wraps into a narrow column of 3 lines ('Thamarassery, / Thamarassery, Change / Kozhikode') because the Driver Mode pill takes the width. The 'Change' link ends up mid-text. Consider a full-width row or truncation.
When place_name equals the taluk name, the text repeats ('Thamarassery, Thamarassery, Kozhikode'). Remove duplicates.

action_items: Optional: when the driver changes the taluk by hand in HomePlacePicker, clear the place if it doesn't match, or check it on the backend
Optional: tidy the dash-taluk layout and remove the repeated place/taluk name
critical_code_review_comments: HomePlacePicker.pickPlace calls onChange({place, taluk: <old taluk>}) before identify-taluk resolves. On /hire/home-location, after a second place pick, Save stays enabled with the previous place's taluk for about 1-3 s, so a quick tap saves a mismatched taluk. Set taluk to null while detecting.
home-location.tsx sends place: null when no place is picked. That is fine, but the city then falls back to the taluk name.
admin_alert runs after the update. Each change creates one notification (no limit, as the user asked), so there is no rate limiting. That is acceptable given the user's choice.

The test driver's home was restored to Kozhikode 5640 and service_taluk_codes to ['5640']. The extra home_history and admin_notifications 'driver_home_changed' entries for test.driver (9 in total, including E1's) were left in place.
